notes.title: V01.00.00d1 HOTFIX
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix Update[/b]

Hey everyone, I’ve just rolled out a small hotfix to address a few issues and make the game a bit more accessible. Here’s what’s included:


[list]
[*] Achievements: Fixed some achievements that were not unlocking properly.
[*] Balance: Adjusted the difficulty of the early stages to make them more accessible for new players.
[*] Bug Fixes: Squashed a few minor bugs.
[/list]


[i]Thanks for your continued support and feedback! See you in the Loop![/i]

notes.title: V00.08.28 HOTFIX
notes.content:
· Some sounds were not linked to SFX volume bar
· Home screen info wasn't updated after spending coins on gacha
· Fixed a movement issue when talking to Zeus
· Fixed several issues with escape menu, now you can hit ESC again to close it
· After unlocking and petting Zeus for the first time, store opens automatically
· Information about icons on combat screen is now updated while hovering
· Zeus unlock cost updated
· Farm is now locked
